# NBAPI 1.5.5

## Claude Opus 5 usage and cache billing

- Added default cache-read and cache-creation ratios for `claude-opus-5`, including provider-qualified and thinking-variant model names.
- Responses requests forced through Chat Completions now always request upstream streaming usage when the channel supports `stream_options`, regardless of the global `FORCE_STREAM_OPTION` switch, preserving cache-read token details for settlement and logs.
- Historical Chat Completions cache-read records contain enough usage data for an administrator to calculate an auditable quota correction. Historical Responses records that used local token estimation do not contain recoverable cache token counts and must be reconciled from upstream billing data rather than guessed.

## Moonshot/Kimi Responses conversion for Codex clients

- Fixed Responses-to-Chat conversion sending empty `system` messages (from `developer` or empty-content items) to Kimi upstreams, which rejected them with `400: the message with role 'system' must not be empty` and caused silent conversation stalls in Codex sessions.
- Reasoning input items are now dropped during conversion instead of being converted into junk user messages; reasoning stays hidden by default.
- `custom_tool_call_output` history items now map to paired `tool` messages by `call_id` instead of becoming empty user messages, preserving sub-agent tool history for Codex's `apply_patch`-style custom tools.
- Moonshot's Responses-to-Chat path now requests upstream streaming usage (`stream_options.include_usage`) so token and cache accounting no longer falls back to local estimation.

## Merge hygiene

- Cleaned up duplicate Responses conversion implementations left by the main-branch merge; the unified `oaichat`/`oai_responses` converters are the single implementation.
- Guarded Chat-to-Claude tool schema conversion against non-string `type` values that previously could panic on malformed client input.
- Restored the ops monitor page in the unified frontend and repaired corrupted alert text encoding.
- The retired synchronous log-deletion route stays retired; use the async system-task log cleanup.

## Compatibility

- No database migration is required. All fixes are request-path or configuration-default changes.
